rewards_interval_exceeds_withdrawal_dela.meaning: rewards are accredited in intervals longer than StakingManager::withdrawalDelay
rewards_interval_exceeds_withdrawal_dela.checkpoint: before the reward event is recorded

reward_event_pending.meaning: a rewards event is about to be recorded and the exchange ratio totalHYPE/totalKHYPESupply is lower because the rewards have not yet been added
reward_event_pending.checkpoint: before the reward event is recorded

stake_before_reward_occurred.meaning: user front-runs the reward event by staking before the rewards are added
stake_before_reward_occurred.checkpoint: after staking, before rewards are added

rewards_captured_by_frontrun_stake.meaning: the front-running staker receives the rewards instead of staking in the intended way, undermining the protocol's intended distribution of rewards
rewards_captured_by_frontrun_stake.checkpoint: after the reward event is recorded

assumptions: The attacker is a user able to stake before the reward event; the report does not claim permissionlessness or a specific authorization state.
The exchange ratio is totalHYPE/totalKHYPESupply and is lower before the pending rewards are added, as stated in p_reward_event_pending.
The reward event is recorded after the front-running stake, so the staker holds shares when rewards are added.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete amounts, timing values, or observed transaction; the reward-capture scenario is only conditional/potential, so no numeric magnitude of captured rewards can be bound.

Report does not specify whether the exchange ratio is manipulable within a single transaction versus only timing-dependent, so the exact temporal relation between stake and reward recording is not fully defined.

limitations: Formalizes only the reward-capture impact; the slashing-avoidance impact and significant-profits impact are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
The reward-distribution integrity intent is represented as the absence of reward capture by a front-running stake; no numeric distribution formula is supplied by the report.
The attacker's authorization status is not claimed by the report and is not encoded as a precondition.
